title: Surreal Cosmic Journey
description: An elderly man in a green coat walks with a cane along a cracked yellow-lined road through a desert landscape, carrying a blue robot on his back. The surreal scene includes purple bushes, cacti, Egyptian pyramids, floating geometric shapes, a large red ringed planet with figures on it, and various people in the distance under a black starry sky.
